metadata.name: fade
metadata.description: Fade — a permissionless payout protocol for Solana

instructions.name: apply_params
docs: Anyone, once the pending change is due.

instructions.name: cancel_params
docs: Council only.

instructions.name: claim_deposit
docs: Anyone: the request's own `CLAIM_FEE` pays whoever claims it.

accounts.name: record
docs: Exists only once the request's epoch has been struck; absent once the
request is parked.

accounts.name: owner_shares
docs: handler delivers to it only if it can receive.

accounts.name: owner_destination
docs: another share account of the owner's, checked to be able to receive.

instructions.name: claim_payout
docs: Anyone: delivers a payout parked at settlement or at a refund.

accounts.name: beneficiary
docs: The beneficiary stored at open — the only destination.

instructions.name: claim_round_payout
docs: Anyone, never paused: delivers a beacon ticket's payout or return
parked in `payout_escrow`, and closes the ticket to its payer.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: A parked beacon ticket, at `["round-ticket", integrator, nonce]` with
its stored bump.

accounts.name: destination
docs: The only destination: `ticket.beneficiary` for a parked payout,
`ticket.refund_to` for a parked return (`BeneficiaryMismatch`).

accounts.name: payer
docs: ticket holds, its rent and what it kept for it at settlement.

instructions.name: claim_shares
docs: Anyone, never paused: the protocol's beacon shares to the treasury, or,
with `integrator`, its app shares to its share account; the whole
claimable ledger, which a destination unable to receive keeps.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; nobody is paid to claim.

accounts.name: integrator
docs: The integrator whose app shares are claimed, at
`["integrator", authority]` with its stored bump; absent for the
protocol's shares.

accounts.name: destination
docs: (`TreasuryMismatch`), `integrator.share_account` with it
(`ShareAccountMismatch`); inspected before the transfer, which is
made only if it can receive (`DestinationUnusable`).

accounts.name: at_record
docs: The record the chain is read at: the request's own epoch or a later one
of the same chain. The final claim reads the one that ends the chain; a
record where the chain splits carries the request into the next chain.
Absent once the request is parked.

accounts.name: entry_record
docs: The request's own record, when it is not `at_record` and this is the
request's first claim: it holds the chain indices at entry.

accounts.name: owner_usdc
docs: handler delivers to it only if it can receive.

accounts.name: owner_destination
docs: another USDC account of the owner's, checked to be able to receive.

instructions.name: expire_round
docs: Anyone, never paused, once `T_SETTLE` has passed since the close of a
paid round whose draw was never requested, or never fulfilled: the
round forfeits as a whole and leaves the epoch counters. Its tickets'
credits stay with the vault; each ticket's payer gets back its prepay
less its charge through `return_round_ticket`. A round never requested
whose entropy was never recorded and is no longer proven by SlotHashes
is refunded instead: whether its request exists, fulfilled, can no
longer be checked.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; unpaid itself, each forfeited ticket's return pays its
settlement share.

accounts.name: round
docs: The round, at `["round", id]` with its stored bump.

accounts.name: round_vrf
docs: `["round-vrf", round]` with the round's stored bump: holds what ORAO
gave back and anything sent to it since the request; drained to the
round when the round was requested.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: requested; when it was not, ORAO's request address for the round's
seed, recorded or proven by SlotHashes; any account when neither (the
round is then refunded, nothing read). Address, owner and state
checked in the handler.

accounts.name: slot_hashes
docs: round never requested whose seed is not recorded.

instructions.name: expire_ticket
docs: Anyone, after `T_SETTLE`, if the randomness never arrived: forfeiture.
Refused while a request at the ticket's seed is fulfilled, bound or
not; a ticket never requested needs its seed recorded first.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: request address derived from its recorded seed; checked in the handler.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: One-time setup by the program's upgrade authority; seeds the strike fund.
The beacon starts paused (`PAUSE_ROUNDS`): the council turns it on.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority: the one party that could
already do anything, so no new trust is created. Pays every rent and
seeds the strike fund.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: `Account<Mint>` of the legacy token module: a Token-2022 mint fails the owner check.

accounts.name: protocol_treasury
docs: Where the protocol share goes. Any USDC token account; its owner is the council's business.

instructions.name: join_round
docs: Signed by the integrator and the funder, as `open_ticket`: a beacon
ticket admitted on entry into the round accepting tickets, or into the
next round, which the join then creates. `sponsorship` lamports from
the payer go to the round's draw with it; 0 for none.

accounts.name: integrator_authority
docs: The integrator's identity, as in `open_ticket` (Spec 07 §2).

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the ticket's rent, the draw prepay, the settlement share, the
sponsorship and, if this join creates them, the round's and the
sponsorship record's rent. Gets back what is not spent.

accounts.name: funder
docs: Owns `funder_usdc` and signs for the ticket price.

accounts.name: funder_usdc
docs: Where the ticket price comes from; stored as `refund_to`.

accounts.name: integrator
docs: Created by the integrator's first ticket on either path; never closed.

accounts.name: share_account
docs: then checked in the handler as a usable USDC account and stored. No
share is paid at the join, so it is not read otherwise.

accounts.name: beneficiary
docs: Any legacy-SPL USDC account; stored, and the only place a payout can go.

accounts.name: payout_table
docs: Owner and discriminator checked by Anchor; its address against its
stored hash in the handler (`WrongPayoutTable`), in the check order.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: Never `init_if_needed`: the address is nonce-scoped and one-shot.

accounts.name: round
docs: round and the round this join creates, if any (round resolution).

accounts.name: sponsorship_record
docs: `sponsorship > 0`; matched against the derived address in the handler,
created or topped up there.

accounts.name: orao_network_state
docs: id; read, owner checked, on every join: its fee sets a created round's
prefund and must still fit the target round's.

instructions.name: open_ticket
docs: Signed by the integrator — a program over CPI with its `["fade-integrator"]`
PDA, or a server or wallet — and by the funder.

accounts.name: integrator_authority
docs: The integrator's identity: a program signs with its `["fade-integrator"]`
PDA through `invoke_signed`, a server or a wallet with its own key.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the ticket's rent, the oracle prefund and the crank fee; receives
every refund when the ticket closes.

accounts.name: funder
docs: Owns `funder_usdc`, pays the ticket price, and signs this very instruction: the
user, or an app paying from funds it holds for its users or its own budget.

accounts.name: integrator
docs: Created by the integrator's first ticket; never re-initialised, never closed.

accounts.name: share_account
docs: that it may be the funder's own USDC account — a user acting as its own
integrator. Stored by the first ticket, and must equal the stored one after.

accounts.name: beneficiary
docs: Any legacy-SPL USDC account; stored, and the only place a payout can go.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: Never `init_if_needed`: the address is nonce-scoped and one-shot.

accounts.name: orao_network_state
docs: owner checked in the handler; the fee is read from it, never set by Fade.

instructions.name: reclaim_sponsorship
docs: Anyone, never paused, once the round is drawn, forfeited or refunded:
the sponsor's return and the record's rent to the sponsor.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone: the return goes to the sponsor whoever sends it.

accounts.name: round
docs: The round, at `["round", id]` with its stored bump.

accounts.name: sponsorship
docs: The record, at `["sponsorship", round, sponsor]` with its stored bump,
of this round; closed here, its rent to the sponsor.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: and the record's lamports.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: no sponsorship, and then must be `round.rent_payer`
(`RentReceiverRequired`); not read otherwise.

instructions.name: record_round_entropy
docs: Anyone, never paused, unpaid: records a paid round's seed and entropy
slot while SlotHashes proves them (from two slots after its close, for
about 512 slots), so that finding its ORAO request never depends on
the sysvar again. Succeeds without writing on a round already recorded.

accounts.name: round
docs: The round, at `["round", id]` with its stored bump.

instructions.name: record_ticket_entropy
docs: Anyone, never paused, unpaid: records an Open ticket's seed and
entropy slot while SlotHashes proves them (from two slots after its
open, for about 512 slots), so that finding its ORAO request never
depends on the sysvar again. Succeeds without writing on a ticket
already recorded.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: The ticket, at `["ticket", integrator, nonce]` with its stored bump.

instructions.name: refund_expired_ticket
docs: Anyone, never paused, paid the settler's share, after `T_SETTLE`: an
Open ticket whose seed was never recorded and whose entropy slot
SlotHashes no longer proves gets its vault credit back, since whether
its request exists, fulfilled, can no longer be checked.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; receives the settler's share of the crank fee.

instructions.name: refund_round
docs: A participant of the round (its ticket's payer, funder or integrator),
or anyone when the round's draw no longer fits its prefund at ORAO's
live fee, never paused, once the round has taken no join for
`refund_slots`, while its draw is unpaid: the round leaves the vault's
books in one step and takes no more joins; each ticket then gets back
exactly what it put in through `return_round_ticket`.

accounts.name: caller
docs: One of the round's participants (`participant`), or anyone when the
round's draw no longer fits its prefund; nobody is paid to refund

accounts.name: round
docs: The round, at `["round", id]` with its stored bump.

accounts.name: participant
docs: of the round whose payer or funder is `caller`, or whose integrator is
`caller`'s (`["integrator", caller]`). A sponsorship is not one: any
amount, one lamport, makes a record, so it would let an outsider
refund for one fee. Owner, discriminator and fields checked in the
handler (`is_participant`); only read. Ignored for a round whose draw
no longer fits its prefund, which anyone may refund.

accounts.name: orao_network_state
docs: id, owner checked in the handler, as `join_round` reads it: its live fee
tells whether the round's draw still fits its prefund (`request_fits`).

instructions.name: register_payout_table
docs: Anyone, never paused: stores a valid payout table at the address of its
hash. Succeeds without writing if it is stored already.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the account's rent, for good: a payout table is never closed.

accounts.name: payout_table
docs: handler from the argument after the table is validated, never taken
from the caller; created there, or read if the program owns it already.

accounts.name: owner_shares
docs: Where the claim will pay the shares: the owner's canonical account,
created now so that no keeper ever advances someone else's rent.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Only needed when this request opens an epoch (Spec 08 §4 rule 1).

accounts.name: request
docs: The epoch is the one the program computes from the queue and the clock,
never an argument: a caller-chosen epoch would choose its price.

instructions.name: request_randomness
docs: Anyone, from two slots after the open until `T_SETTLE`; after it, only
a request someone created through ORAO at the ticket's seed and ORAO
fulfilled with a non-zero value, bound without funding anything.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; receives the requester's share of the crank fee.

instructions.name: request_round_draw
docs: Anyone, never paused, paid the round's request share: one ORAO request
for every ticket of a paid round, from two slots after its close until
`T_SETTLE`. The round's tickets are already in the epoch counters,
recorded when it became paid.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; receives the round's request share.

accounts.name: round
docs: The round, at `["round", id]` with its stored bump.

accounts.name: round_vrf
docs: `["round-vrf", round]` with the round's stored bump: pays ORAO, signed
by the program. System-owned, empty outside the request.

accounts.name: owner_usdc
docs: Where the claim will pay the USDC: the owner's canonical account.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Only needed when this request opens an epoch.

instructions.name: return_round_ticket
docs: Anyone, never paused: one ticket of a refunded or forfeited round
leaves it, with what it is owed. Pays the caller the ticket's
settlement share for a forfeited ticket, nothing for a refunded one.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; paid the ticket's settlement share for a forfeited ticket,
nothing for a refunded one.

accounts.name: round
docs: The ticket's round, at `["round", ticket.round]` with its stored bump.

accounts.name: integrator
docs: The ticket's stored integrator.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: The ticket, at `["round-ticket", integrator, nonce]` with its stored bump.

accounts.name: payer
docs: charge after a forfeiture) and the ticket's rent.

accounts.name: refund_to
docs: a refunded ticket price goes; inspected before any transfer, and not
read for a forfeited ticket.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: no sponsorship, and then must be `round.rent_payer`
(`RentReceiverRequired`); not read otherwise.

instructions.name: set_params
docs: Council only. Applies at once if every change tightens, otherwise queues
it behind the longest delay of the fields it loosens.

accounts.name: protocol_treasury
docs: The treasury the change sets; the current one to leave it alone.

instructions.name: set_pause_flags
docs: The guardian may only set flags; the council may also clear them.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The guardian or the council.

accounts.name: integrator
docs: The integrator whose own pause changes, if any.

instructions.name: set_share_account
docs: Signed by the integrator's authority: the only way to move its share account.

accounts.name: share_account
docs: Any USDC account: an integrator may route its share anywhere.

instructions.name: set_share_metadata
docs: Council only: the share mint's name, symbol and logo in wallets
(Token Metadata). Creates the metadata on the first call, rewrites it after.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the metadata account's rent and Token Metadata's creation fee.

accounts.name: vault_authority
docs: The share mint's mint authority and the metadata's update authority.

accounts.name: metadata
docs: The share mint's metadata PDA under Token Metadata; created on the first call.

instructions.name: settle_round_tickets
docs: Anyone, never paused, once the round's randomness is fulfilled; no
deadline. Settles `count` of its tickets, named in remaining accounts
by groups of `ticket`, `integrator`, `payer`, `payout_table`, then
`beneficiary` exactly when bit `i` of `wins` is set; each checked
against the ticket's stored keys. The first settlement of a round
fixes its draw cost. Pays the caller each ticket's settlement share.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone, once the round's randomness is fulfilled; receives each
settled ticket's settlement share.

accounts.name: round
docs: The round, at `["round", id]` with its stored bump.

accounts.name: round_vrf
docs: `["round-vrf", round]` with the round's stored bump: holds ORAO's rent
refund after the fulfilment, drained by the first settlement.

accounts.name: randomness
docs: owner, kind, seed and value checked in the handler at the first
settlement, the only one that reads it.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: sponsorship, and then must be `round.rent_payer`
(`RentReceiverRequired`); not read otherwise.

instructions.name: settle_ticket
docs: Anyone, once ORAO has fulfilled; no deadline.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone, once ORAO has fulfilled; receives the settler's share of the crank fee.

instructions.name: sponsor_round
docs: Anyone, never paused: `lamports` to a round's draw, until its request.
Returned pro rata after a draw or a forfeiture, in full after a refund.

accounts.name: sponsor
docs: Pays the sponsorship and, for a new record, its rent; gets back what
the draw does not use, and the rent, through `reclaim_sponsorship`.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Its epoch counters record the round's tickets if this sponsorship pays it.

accounts.name: round
docs: The round, at `["round", id]` with its stored bump.

accounts.name: sponsorship
docs: address, created or topped up in the handler by the same function as
`join_round`'s record (`ConstraintSeeds`, `AccountOwnedByWrongProgram`).

accounts.name: orao_network_state
docs: id, owner checked when read: the round's draw must still fit its
prefund, as for a join (`DrawUnderfunded`).

accounts.name: config
docs: The config, at `["config"]` with its stored bump: its pause flags.

instructions.name: strike_epoch
docs: Anyone, once the live epoch has closed and no ticket opened before the
close is still open.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; advances the record's rent, which the strike fund reimburses,
and receives `STRIKE_REWARD` from the fund.

accounts.name: record
docs: Written once; afterwards only its count of pending readers changes.

instructions.name: sweep_round_vrf
docs: Anyone, never paused, unpaid: the lamports on round `round_id`'s
`round_vrf` after its last drain (ORAO's refund for a request fulfilled
after the round forfeited, or a transfer), into the round while it
exists and is not `Requested`, to the caller once it has closed.
Nothing to sweep succeeds without moving anything.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; receives what a closed round's `round_vrf` holds, nothing
otherwise.

accounts.name: vault
docs: Read for `next_round_id`: only a round the vault created is swept.

accounts.name: round
docs: `Round` while the program owns it; any other owner means the round has
closed (a round's address is never used again), and it is not read.

accounts.name: round_vrf
docs: `["round-vrf", round]`, signed by the program.

instructions.name: sweep_ticket_vrf
docs: Anyone, never paused, unpaid: the lamports on a closed direct ticket's
`vrf_payer` (ORAO's refund for a request fulfilled after the ticket
expired, or a transfer), to the caller. Nothing to sweep succeeds
without moving anything.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone; receives what a closed ticket's `vrf_payer` holds.

accounts.name: integrator
docs: Read for `next_nonce`: only a ticket the integrator opened is swept.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: its owner is read: a ticket's address is never used again, so any
owner but this program means the ticket has closed.

accounts.name: vrf_payer
docs: `["vrf-payer", ticket]`, signed by the program.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: signer is not the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: InvalidParams
errors.msg: parameters are out of range

errors.name: Paused
errors.msg: this operation is paused

errors.name: NotCouncil
errors.msg: signer is not the council

errors.name: NotGuardian
errors.msg: signer is neither the council nor the guardian

errors.name: GuardianCannotUnpause
errors.msg: the guardian may only set pause flags, never clear them

errors.name: NoPendingChange
errors.msg: no parameter change is pending

errors.name: ChangeNotDue
errors.msg: the pending parameter change is not due yet

errors.name: WrongMint
errors.msg: wrong mint

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: arithmetic overflow

errors.name: ZeroAmount
errors.msg: amount must be non-zero

errors.name: RemainingAccounts
errors.msg: unexpected remaining accounts

errors.name: OutcomeCount
errors.msg: payout table: zero outcomes or more than 32

errors.name: ProbabilityRange
errors.msg: payout table: a probability of zero or above 1

errors.name: ProbabilitySum
errors.msg: payout table: probabilities do not sum to exactly 1

errors.name: MultiplierCeiling
errors.msg: payout table: a multiplier above 10 000x

errors.name: PayoutTableOverpays
errors.msg: payout table: pays out more than it takes in on average

errors.name: MarginFloor
errors.msg: payout table margin does not cover the vault margin floor plus the protocol and app shares

errors.name: AppShareTooHigh
errors.msg: app share above the maximum

errors.name: PriceBounds
errors.msg: ticket price below the minimum or above the maximum

errors.name: PerTicketCap
errors.msg: worst-case payout above the per-ticket cap

errors.name: IntegratorCap
errors.msg: integrator exposure above its ceiling

errors.name: UtilisationBreaker
errors.msg: utilisation breaker: the vault is too committed

errors.name: GlobalExposure
errors.msg: reserved liability would exceed kappa of assets

errors.name: Insolvent
errors.msg: the vault could not pay every open ticket at once

errors.name: DrawdownBreaker
errors.msg: drawdown breaker: the share price fell too far in 24 hours

errors.name: WrongNonce
errors.msg: ticket nonce must equal the integrator's next nonce

errors.name: IntegratorPaused
errors.msg: this integrator is paused

errors.name: ShareAccountMismatch
errors.msg: share account differs from the integrator record

errors.name: WrongTicketStatus
errors.msg: the ticket is not in the state this instruction needs

errors.name: RequestWindow
errors.msg: randomness may only be requested from two slots after the open until T_SETTLE

errors.name: EntropyUnavailable
errors.msg: SlotHashes holds no slot after the open

errors.name: NetworkStateUnreadable
errors.msg: ORAO network state could not be read

errors.name: TreasuryMismatch
errors.msg: treasury does not match ORAO network state

errors.name: WrongRandomnessAccount
errors.msg: randomness account is not the one bound to this ticket

errors.name: NotFulfilled
errors.msg: randomness is not fulfilled

errors.name: AlreadyFulfilled
errors.msg: randomness is fulfilled: settle, do not expire

errors.name: NotExpired
errors.msg: T_SETTLE has not elapsed

errors.name: DrawFailed
errors.msg: no outcome could be drawn

errors.name: BeneficiaryMismatch
errors.msg: beneficiary differs from the one stored at open

errors.name: NoLiveEpoch
errors.msg: no epoch is live

errors.name: EpochNotClosed
errors.msg: the epoch has not closed yet

errors.name: StrikeNotClean
errors.msg: a ticket opened before the close is still open

errors.name: BelowMinimum
errors.msg: request below the minimum

errors.name: FirstDepositTooSmall
errors.msg: a first deposit must be at least min_first_deposit

errors.name: ForbiddenComposition
errors.msg: a top-level instruction of this transaction is not allowed with a request

errors.name: WrongRecord
errors.msg: the record does not belong to this request's epoch or chain

errors.name: EntryRecordRequired
errors.msg: the epoch record of the request's entry is required

errors.name: RentReceiverRequired
errors.msg: the account that advanced the record's rent is required

errors.name: NothingToClaim
errors.msg: nothing to claim yet

errors.name: WrongOwner
errors.msg: wrong owner

errors.name: NotStruck
errors.msg: the request's epoch has not been struck

errors.name: VaultRequired
errors.msg: this request opens an epoch: the vault account is required

errors.name: DestinationUnusable
errors.msg: the owner's token account cannot receive yet

errors.name: WrongRound
errors.msg: the round is neither the accepting round nor the next one

errors.name: RoundNotAccepting
errors.msg: the round accepts no more sponsorship

errors.name: RoundCapacity
errors.msg: the round's liability would exceed what its paid share of the draw allows

errors.name: RoundPaid
errors.msg: the round's draw is paid: no refund

errors.name: WrongRoundStatus
errors.msg: the round is not in the state this instruction needs

errors.name: RefundWindow
errors.msg: the round's refund window has not opened

errors.name: RoundRequestWindow
errors.msg: a round's draw may only be requested from two slots after its close until T_SETTLE

errors.name: DrawUnderfunded
errors.msg: the live draw cost exceeds the round's prefund

errors.name: WrongPayoutTable
errors.msg: the payout table account does not match its hash or the ticket

errors.name: NotCanceller
errors.msg: unused: kept so that the codes after it do not move

errors.name: ShareAccountRequired
errors.msg: an integrator's first ticket must name its share account

errors.name: MalformedBatch
errors.msg: the settlement accounts do not follow the ticket layout

errors.name: RoundEpochClosed
errors.msg: a round counted before the epoch's close takes no join at or after that close

errors.name: NotRoundParticipant
errors.msg: only a participant of the round, shown by its ticket, may refund it

errors.name: EntropyUnrecorded
errors.msg: the entropy was never recorded and SlotHashes no longer proves it

errors.name: EntropyStillProven
errors.msg: SlotHashes still proves the ticket's entropy: record it and expire the ticket

types.name: ClaimDelivered
docs: A parked claim handed over once the owner's account could receive.

fields.name: deposit
docs: A deposit request (shares) or a withdrawal request (USDC).

fields.name: vault_authority_bump
docs: Bump of `["vault-authority"]`, which owns every token account.

fields.name: council
docs: Parameter authority, and the only party that lifts a pause.

fields.name: guardian
docs: May only set pause flags.

fields.name: protocol_treasury
docs: USDC token account receiving the protocol share.

fields.name: pause_flags
docs: Bit set: see `Config::PAUSE_*`.

fields.name: delivered
docs: The shares reached the owner; otherwise they are parked on the request.

fields.name: parked
docs: Set by a claim that could not deliver: the owner's share account could
not receive. The epoch's record is released; `shares_due` waits here.

types.name: EpochRecord
docs: Written once by the strike; only `pending` changes afterwards (Spec 08 §2.3).

fields.name: total_assets
docs: The vault's settled assets and its shares at the strike, before its
flows: these fix the price.

fields.name: chain_id
docs: The epoch id the withdrawal chain this strike belongs to started at.

fields.name: pending
docs: Requests whose remaining claims still read this record.

fields.name: requests
docs: Requests made in this epoch.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Where the rent goes when the record closes: the queue (the strike fund
advanced it) or the striker (the fund could not).

types.name: Integrator
docs: An integrator's record, keyed on the address that signs its tickets (Spec 08 §2.5).
Never closed, so its nonce can never restart.

fields.name: share_account
docs: USDC account receiving the app share; changed only by `set_share_account`.

fields.name: paused
docs: Set by the guardian or the council: this integrator's new tickets are refused.

fields.name: app_shares_accrued
docs: App shares of its settled and forfeited beacon tickets, not yet claimed
(Spec 08 §13.2.6); taken from the reserved tail.

types.name: LiveEpoch
docs: One live epoch in `Queue` (Spec 08 §2.2).

fields.name: close_ts
docs: 0 for `next` until it is promoted.

fields.name: withdraw_shares
docs: Queued withdrawal shares, including those rolled from a rationed strike.

fields.name: withdraw_requests
docs: New withdrawal requests of this epoch; rolled ones are counted by the chain.

fields.name: p
docs: Probability in 1e-9.

fields.name: m
docs: Multiplier in bps.

types.name: ParamsChanged
docs: `set_params` applied a change at once (`effective_at` = now) or queued it.

fields.name: integrator
docs: The integrator whose pause changed, or the default key.

types.name: PayoutTable
docs: A payout table stored once, at `["payout-table", hash]` (Spec 08 §13.2.1).
Immutable and never closed: a beacon ticket stores its address instead of
its outcomes. It holds no share and no margin floor, which depend on the
ticket's app share and the live parameters and are checked at each join.

fields.name: lhs
docs: `Σ p·m` of the outcomes, from `payout_table::validate`.

fields.name: max_m
docs: The largest multiplier, in bps.

fields.name: hash
docs: `SHA256("FADE/PAYOUT-TABLE/v1" ‖ len ‖ p₀ ‖ m₀ ‖ …)`, little-endian `u64`s.

types.name: PayoutTableRegistered
docs: `register_payout_table` created a payout table; a re-registration emits nothing.

fields.name: outcomes
docs: The `len` outcomes `hash` commits to, so the table is known from the events alone.

types.name: PendingChange
docs: At most one queued parameter change (Spec 08 §7).

types.name: Queue
docs: The liquidity-provider side (Spec 08 §2.2). Its lamports above its own
rent-exempt minimum are the strike fund.

fields.name: next_epoch_id
docs: The id the next epoch to be created receives. Starts at 1.

fields.name: chain_id
docs: The epoch id the running withdrawal chain started at, or 0.

fields.name: chain_r
docs: Chain indices of Spec 08 §5, `INDEX_SCALE` fixed point.

fields.name: chain_requests
docs: Withdrawal requests of struck epochs still waiting for the chain to end.

types.name: RiskParams
docs: Governable parameters: the Technical Specification's §2 table. Settlement
never reads them; everything a ticket needs is snapshotted at open.

fields.name: kelly_fraction_bps
docs: Fraction of the Kelly-optimal liability a ticket may take, in bps.

fields.name: censorship_bps
docs: Flat ceiling on a ticket's liability as a fraction of assets, in bps.

fields.name: whale_bps
docs: One integrator's open liability as a fraction of assets, in bps.

fields.name: utilisation_breaker_bps
docs: Committed fraction of assets above which new tickets are refused, in bps.

fields.name: kappa_bps
docs: Reserved liability as a fraction of assets never exceeded, in bps.

fields.name: drawdown_bps
docs: Fall of the share price within 24 hours that stops new tickets, in bps.

fields.name: min_vault_margin_bps
docs: Smallest share of the ticket price the vault must earn in expectation, in bps.

fields.name: protocol_share_bps
docs: Taken from the ticket price at open, to the treasury, in bps.

fields.name: t_settle_slots
docs: Slots from open after which an unfulfilled ticket can be expired.

fields.name: crank_request_lamports
docs: Part of the crank fee paid to whoever requests the randomness, lamports.

fields.name: crank_settle_lamports
docs: Part of the crank fee paid to whoever settles or expires, lamports.

fields.name: claim_fee_lamports
docs: Held in each request, paid to whoever claims it, lamports.

fields.name: strike_fee_lamports
docs: Paid into the strike fund by a request while the fund is below target, lamports.

fields.name: strike_reward_lamports
docs: Paid from the strike fund to whoever strikes an epoch, lamports.

fields.name: min_deposit
docs: Smallest deposit request, USDC base units.

fields.name: min_withdraw_shares
docs: Smallest withdrawal request, in share base units, unless it is the owner's whole balance.

fields.name: min_first_deposit
docs: Smallest deposit while no share exists.

fields.name: beacon_min_price
docs: Smallest beacon ticket price, USDC base units.

fields.name: beacon_threshold
docs: `T_r`: the ticket prices that pay a round's whole draw, USDC base units.

fields.name: round_k
docs: `k`: per-ticket caps a paid round may carry; at most `MAX_ROUND_K`.

fields.name: tick_slots
docs: A paid round closes at the next multiple of `tick_slots`.

fields.name: refund_slots
docs: Slots after a round's latest join from which an unpaid round may be refunded.

fields.name: crank_round_settle_lamports
docs: Settlement share of a beacon ticket, paid to whoever settles or returns it, lamports.

types.name: Round
docs: One draw shared by the tickets that joined it, at `["round", id]`
(Spec 08 §13.2.2). Prepays and sponsorship are held in its lamports.

fields.name: vrf_bump
docs: Bump of `["round-vrf", round]`.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Advanced the round's rent; receives it, with the dust, at close.

fields.name: first_slot
docs: Slot of the first join.

fields.name: paid_slot
docs: Slot in which the round became paid; 0 until then.

fields.name: close_slot
docs: First tick boundary after `paid_slot`; 0 until paid.

fields.name: threshold
docs: `T_r`, USDC base units.

fields.name: draw_max
docs: `D_r`, lamports: two ORAO fees, a pending request's rent and the request share.

fields.name: prices
docs: `R`: ticket prices of every ticket that joined.

fields.name: sponsorship
docs: `S`: sponsorship received, lamports.

fields.name: prepaid
docs: Prepays held on the round and not yet returned, lamports.

fields.name: usage
docs: `U`: Σ of the tickets' capacity usage, `USAGE_SCALE` fixed point.

fields.name: tickets
docs: Tickets joined and not yet settled or returned.

fields.name: sponsors
docs: Sponsorships not yet reclaimed.

fields.name: counted
docs: Recorded in the epoch counters.

fields.name: randomness
docs: The ORAO request account.

fields.name: seed
docs: The round's seed and its entropy slot `s*`, recorded while SlotHashes
proves `s*` by `record_round_entropy`, `request_round_draw` or the
expiry that looked for its request; zero until then. Once recorded,
the round's ORAO request address no longer depends on SlotHashes.

fields.name: funded
docs: Lamports moved to `round_vrf` for the request.

fields.name: draw_cost
docs: `C`, fixed by the first settlement or the expiry.

fields.name: drawn_randomness
docs: `R`, the request's randomness, kept by the first settlement; zero
until then. Every later batch reads it here, so that a drawn round
never depends on ORAO's account staying readable (invariant 10).

fields.name: last_join_slot
docs: Slot of the latest join; the refund window counts from it (Spec 09 §6
as built). Taken from the spare tail: a round written before it reads
0, and `refund_from` then counts from `first_slot`.

fields.name: entropy_hash
docs: `h*`; zero when the round's entropy was recorded before the request and
SlotHashes no longer holds `s*` (a late binding): `RoundEntropyRecorded`
carries it then.

fields.name: side
docs: The epoch counter the round's tickets joined when it became paid, and
its generation; the request does not change them.

types.name: RoundDrawn
docs: The first settlement of a round read its randomness and fixed its draw cost.

fields.name: refund
docs: Lamports drained back from `round_vrf`.

types.name: RoundEntropyRecorded
docs: A paid round's seed and entropy slot, recorded while SlotHashes proved `s*`:
its ORAO request address no longer depends on the sysvar.

types.name: RoundExpired
docs: `requested` tells a keeper's failure (false) from a withheld draw (true).

fields.name: request_found
docs: An ORAO request exists for the round's seed: bound when `requested`, created
through ORAO by someone and never bound otherwise (pending or fulfilled with zero).

fields.name: checked
docs: The program could look for that request: always when `requested`; for a round
never requested, while SlotHashes still proved its entropy slot. The alarm reads a
keeper's failure only from `checked && !request_found`.

fields.name: forfeited
docs: Vault credits forfeited to the vault.

fields.name: draw_cost
docs: `C` (Spec 08 §13.4), which every forfeited return's charge depends on, and the
lamports drained back from `round_vrf` that fixed it; both 0 when unrequested.

fields.name: side
docs: The epoch counter the round's tickets left and its generation, recorded when the
round became paid: no other event gives them for a round never requested.

fields.name: forfeits_withheld
docs: `Vault.forfeits_withheld` after this expiry: when it counts as one a withheld
draw may explain (all but `!requested && checked && !request_found`), its
ordinal in that count, which the keeper's alarm accounts for one by one.

fields.name: refunded
docs: The round was refunded, not forfeited: never requested, its entropy never
recorded, and SlotHashes no longer proving it, so that whether its request
exists, fulfilled, can no longer be checked (`checked` false). Every ticket's
price and prepay go back at its return; `forfeited`, `draw_cost` and `refund`
are 0.

types.name: RoundOpened
docs: A join created a round; the round's snapshot (Spec 09 §3).

fields.name: total
docs: The round's sponsorship after this one.

types.name: RoundStatus
docs: Where a round stands (Spec 08 §13.2.2). "Closed" is not a state: a `Paid`
round is closed from `close_slot` on, computed from the slot.

types.name: RoundTicket
docs: A beacon ticket, at `["round-ticket", integrator, nonce]` (Spec 08 §13.2.4).
Lean: the payout table is referenced by address, and everything common to
the round is on the round.

fields.name: round
docs: The round's id.

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the rent, the prepay and the settlement share; gets back what is not spent.

fields.name: funder
docs: Signed for the ticket price.

fields.name: refund_to
docs: The funder's token account: where a refund returns the ticket price.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Stored at the join, immutable: the only account a payout can go to.

fields.name: payout_table
docs: The `PayoutTable` account.

fields.name: prepay
docs: Lamports held on the round for the draw.

fields.name: settle_share
docs: Lamports held on this account above its rent, for whoever settles or returns it.

fields.name: payout
docs: Set when the payout or the return is parked.

fields.name: refunded
docs: A refunded round (the ticket price returned), or a forfeited one.

fields.name: lamports
docs: Lamports returned to the payer.

fields.name: parked
docs: The ticket price went to `payout_escrow`: `refund_to` could not receive it.

fields.name: charge
docs: The ticket's share of the draw, lamports: 0 after a refund.

fields.name: charge
docs: The ticket's share of the draw, lamports.

fields.name: pending
docs: The payout went to `payout_escrow`: the beneficiary could not receive it.

types.name: RoundVrfSwept
docs: Lamports that reached a round's `round_vrf` after its last drain (ORAO's rent
refund for a request fulfilled after the round forfeited, or a transfer), swept.

fields.name: round
docs: The round's address, whether it still exists or not.

fields.name: to
docs: The round while it exists (its close pays them to `rent_payer`), the caller
once it has closed.

fields.name: closed
docs: The round had closed: `to` is the caller.

types.name: ShareMetadataSet
docs: `set_share_metadata` created the share mint's Token Metadata account, or
rewrote it (`created` false).

types.name: SharesClaimed
docs: `integrator` is the default key for the protocol's shares.

types.name: Sponsorship
docs: One sponsor's lamports in one round, at `["sponsorship", round, sponsor]`
(Spec 08 §13.2.5). A second sponsorship by the same sponsor tops it up.

fields.name: round
docs: The round's id.

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the rent and the SOL; receives every refund and the rent at close.

fields.name: beneficiary
docs: Stored at open, immutable: the only account a payout can go to.

fields.name: cap
docs: The per-ticket cap that applied at open.

fields.name: drawdown_bps
docs: The drawdown threshold at open: settlement records a trip against it
without reading live parameters.

fields.name: expiry_slot
docs: `open_slot + T_SETTLE`, fixed at open: after it an unfulfilled ticket can be expired.

fields.name: side
docs: Which epoch counter the ticket joined, and in which generation.

fields.name: crank_request_lamports
docs: Lamports of crank fee still held for the requester and the settler.

fields.name: randomness
docs: The ORAO request account, bound by `request_randomness`.

fields.name: entropy_slot
docs: `s*`, `h*` and the ORAO seed, recorded by `record_ticket_entropy` or
`request_randomness`; all zero until then.

fields.name: outcome
docs: The outcome drawn, or `REFUND_OUTCOME` for a refund parked in
`payout_escrow`; 0 until either.

fields.name: payout
docs: Set when the payout (or the refunded credit) waits in `payout_escrow`.

types.name: TicketEntropyRecorded
docs: An Open direct ticket's seed and entropy slot, recorded while SlotHashes
proved `s*`: its ORAO request address no longer depends on the sysvar.

types.name: TicketExpired
docs: A direct ticket's expiry: forfeited by `expire_ticket`, or refunded by
`refund_expired_ticket`. Version 2 (`TICKET_EXPIRED_VERSION`); a version-1
body ends after `forfeited`.

fields.name: forfeited
docs: The vault credit forfeited to the vault; 0 for a refund.

fields.name: requested
docs: The ticket's randomness was requested: its bound request was pending or
fulfilled with zero.

fields.name: request_found
docs: An ORAO request exists at the ticket's seed: bound when `requested`,
created through ORAO by someone and never bound otherwise (pending or
fulfilled with zero).

fields.name: checked
docs: The program could look for that request: always for a forfeiture,
never for a refund. The alarm reads a keeper's failure only from
`checked && !request_found`.

fields.name: pending
docs: The bound request was still pending and `vrf_payer` paid its rent, so
ORAO's rent refund reaches `vrf_payer` when it fulfils it, after the
ticket's close, and `sweep_ticket_vrf` moves it then. False for a
request someone else created and the ticket bound: ORAO refunds its
creator.

fields.name: refunded
docs: The ticket was refunded, not forfeited: never requested, its seed never
recorded, and SlotHashes no longer proving it.

fields.name: refund
docs: The vault credit returned to the beneficiary (or parked in
`payout_escrow`); 0 unless `refunded`.

fields.name: parked
docs: The refund waits in `payout_escrow` for `claim_payout`: the beneficiary
could not receive it. The ticket stays, `PayoutPending` with `outcome`
`REFUND_OUTCOME`.

fields.name: ticket_forfeits_withheld
docs: `Vault.ticket_forfeits_withheld` after this expiry: when it counts as
one a withheld draw may explain (all but `!requested && checked &&
!request_found`), its ordinal in that count.

fields.name: cap
docs: The per-ticket cap admission applied, and the capacity usage against it.

fields.name: pending
docs: The payout went to `payout_escrow`: the beneficiary could not receive it.

types.name: TicketVrfSwept
docs: Lamports that reached a closed direct ticket's `vrf_payer` (ORAO's rent
refund for a request fulfilled after the ticket expired, or a transfer),
swept to the caller.

fields.name: ticket
docs: The ticket's address; the ticket no longer exists.

types.name: Vault
docs: The ticket side (Spec 08 §2.1). Never written by a liquidity-provider
instruction except the strike and the request that opens an epoch.

fields.name: total_assets
docs: Everything the vault owns, tracked internally — never read from a token account.

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Equal to the share mint's supply; only the strike mints and burns.

fields.name: total_reserved_liability
docs: `Σ payout_max − vault_credit` of open tickets.

fields.name: open_vault_credits
docs: `Σ vault_credit` of open tickets.

fields.name: open_before_close
docs: Open tickets opened before the live epoch's close (Spec 08 §4).

fields.name: open_after_close
docs: Open tickets opened at or after it, or while no epoch was live.

fields.name: close_ts
docs: The live epoch's close, or 0.

fields.name: price_maxima
docs: Highest share price of each of the last 24 hours (Spec 08 §8).

fields.name: drawdown_trip_ts
docs: Last time the drawdown condition was seen holding.

fields.name: volume_total
docs: Cumulative ticket price ever opened.

fields.name: after_close_gain
docs: Results of tickets opened after the live close that have already closed:
what the vault gained (`vault_credit − payout`) and lost on them. A strike
leaves them out of its price; they are the next epoch's (Spec 08 §4 rule 5).

fields.name: accepting_round
docs: Id of the round accepting tickets, or 0.

fields.name: next_round_id
docs: Id the next round created receives; starts at 1.

fields.name: beacon_shares_held
docs: Protocol and app shares of beacon tickets joined and not yet settled,
returned or forfeited: in `vault_usdc`, outside `total_assets`.

fields.name: protocol_shares_accrued
docs: Protocol shares of settled and forfeited beacon tickets, not yet claimed.

fields.name: app_shares_owed
docs: `Σ Integrator.app_shares_accrued`.

fields.name: beacon_returns_owed
docs: Ticket prices of refunded rounds' tickets not yet returned.

fields.name: rounds_forfeited
docs: Rounds `expire_round` has forfeited, ever.

fields.name: forfeits_withheld
docs: The expiries a withheld draw may explain: every forfeiture but one of
a round never requested whose request the program looked for and did
not find (`RoundExpired`'s `!requested && checked && !request_found`,
the keepers' failure), and every round `expire_round` refunded because
its entropy was never recorded and SlotHashes no longer proves it
(`RoundExpired.refunded`). A durable count, so that an alarm never has
to infer a withheld draw from transaction history it could not read.

fields.name: ticket_forfeits_withheld
docs: The direct expiries a withheld draw may explain, by the same rule as
`forfeits_withheld` (`TicketExpired`'s `requested || request_found ||
!checked`, every refund included), kept apart so that each path's
alarm accounts for its own ordinals. Taken from the reserved tail.

fields.name: at_epoch_id
docs: The record the claim read the chain at.

fields.name: closed
docs: The request is fully served and closed.

fields.name: delivered
docs: What was owed reached the owner; otherwise it is parked on the request.

fields.name: r_entry
docs: Chain indices at entry, copied from the entry record by the first claim; 0 before.

fields.name: paid
docs: Assets already paid by earlier partial claims.

fields.name: chain_id
docs: The chain the request entered, copied with the indices; every later
claim must read a record of this chain. A split carries the request into
the next chain: its remaining `shares` at indices `START`.

fields.name: undelivered
docs: Assets owed but not delivered: the owner's USDC account could not
receive when a claim ran. Delivered by the next claim that can.

fields.name: parked
docs: Set by the final claim when it could not deliver: every record is
released and only `undelivered` remains to hand over.

constants.name: BEACON_OUTCOME_TAG
docs: Domain tag of a beacon ticket's outcome; equal to `fade_math::beacon::OUTCOME_TAG`.

constants.name: BEACON_SEED_TAG
docs: Domain tag of a round's ORAO seed; equal to `fade_math::beacon::SEED_TAG`.

constants.name: DEPOSIT_QUEUE_SEED
docs: Deposits queued for a strike; not part of the vault's assets yet.

constants.name: DEPOSIT_SEED
docs: `["deposit", epoch_id, owner]`.

constants.name: EPOCH_SEED
docs: `["epoch", epoch_id]`.

constants.name: INTEGRATOR_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: The seed a program integrator derives its signing PDA with, under its own
program id: `["fade-integrator"]`. Only that program can sign for it.

constants.name: INTEGRATOR_SEED
docs: `["integrator", authority]`: keyed on the address that signs `open_ticket`.

constants.name: MAX_ROUND_BATCH
docs: Most tickets one `settle_round_tickets` may name: one bit of its `wins`
mask each (Spec 08 §13.5.7). Transaction size binds well below it.

constants.name: MAX_ROUND_K
docs: The most per-ticket caps a round may carry (Spec 08 §13.3). A program
constant, so that raising `k` takes an upgrade behind the 72-hour
timelock rather than a parameter change: Spec 09 §7 ties it to stronger
randomness, itself an upgrade.

constants.name: PAYABLE_SEED
docs: Assets struck withdrawals are owed, not yet claimed.

constants.name: PAYOUT_ESCROW_SEED
docs: Payouts to a beneficiary that could not receive them at settlement.

constants.name: PAYOUT_TABLE_SEED
docs: `["payout-table", hash]`: a payout table stored once, referenced by beacon tickets.

constants.name: PAYOUT_TABLE_TAG
docs: Domain tag of a payout table's hash (Spec 08 §13.2.1); equal to
`fade_math::beacon::PAYOUT_TABLE_TAG`.

constants.name: QUEUE_SEED
docs: The liquidity-provider side's state; its lamports above rent are the strike fund.

constants.name: REFUND_OUTCOME
docs: `Ticket.outcome` of a refund parked in `payout_escrow`: no payout table
holds this index (32 outcomes at most), so a `PayoutPending` ticket
carrying it is a refunded credit waiting for `claim_payout`, never a
settlement. `u8::MAX`, written out so that the IDL and the generated
clients carry the value.

constants.name: ROUND_SEED
docs: `["round", round_id]`, `round_id` little-endian `u64`.

constants.name: ROUND_TICKET_SEED
docs: `["round-ticket", integrator, nonce]`: the nonce is the integrator's
`next_nonce`, shared with the direct path.

constants.name: ROUND_VRF_SEED
docs: `["round-vrf", round]`: the system-owned PDA that pays ORAO for a round's draw.

constants.name: SPONSORSHIP_SEED
docs: `["sponsorship", round, sponsor]`.

constants.name: TICKET_SEED
docs: `["ticket", integrator, nonce]`.

constants.name: USDC_VAULT_SEED
docs: The vault's USDC: backs every open ticket.

constants.name: VAULT_AUTHORITY_SEED
docs: Signs for every token account the vault owns. No data.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: The ticket side's state.

constants.name: VRF_PAYER_SEED
docs: `["vrf-payer", ticket]`: the system-owned PDA that pays ORAO.

constants.name: WITHDRAW_SEED
docs: `["withdraw", epoch_id, owner]`.
